functions.name: Clear
functions.docs: Removes all functions from this delegate's invocation list.

functions.name: IsBound
functions.docs:
Checks to see if any functions are bound to this multi-cast delegate.
@return true if any functions are bound, false otherwise.

functions.name: IsBoundToObject
functions.docs:
Checks to see if any functions are bound to the given user object.
@return	True if any functions are bound to InUserObject, false otherwise.

functions.name: RemoveAll
GetAllocatedSize
functions.docs: Returns the amount of memory allocated by this delegate's invocation list and the delegates stored within it, not including sizeof(*this).
